lines.t:
A mysterious gem that draws out the power of a
<c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>.
Each <c:ffff00>{{medalia_slot}}<c> takes 1 {{medalia}}.
Each {{medalia}} has an {{effect}}, a shape, a color, and an
extra <c:ffff00>{{best_skill}}<c> with its <c:ffff00>{{level_bonus}}<c> (0-99).
If all 3 slots hold {{medalia}} of one shape, the <c:ffff00>{{leader}}<c>
<c:ffff00>{{effect}}<c> changes; of one color, a <c:ffff00>{{medal_change}}<c>
occurs.
